name: Two Worlds Apart
overview: Two baby girls are accidentally switched at birth and raised in each other’s lives. Isabella grows up surrounded by wealth and privilege, unaware that she is not the true heir to the Donovan fortune, while Elena is raised in poverty despite being the rightful daughter of the powerful Donovan family. Their destinies become intertwined when Elena forms an unexpected connection with Adrian, Isabella’s fiancé. As hidden secrets come to light, long-buried truths threaten to upend their lives, forcing both women to confront their identities, family ties, and the future that was stolen from them.
